contents_summary: ZIP holding one two-page landscape PDF, Supplementary File S1: a literature-review table of 124 previously published cases of cutaneous Alternaria phaeohyphomycosis in transplant recipients (page 1: 70 rows, page 2: 54 rows). Columns are reference number, authors, year, country, gender and age, incubation gap in months, site and type of lesion, systemic involvement, fungal identification technique, pathogen, transplant type, surgical treatment, medical treatment, antimicrobial therapy length in months, outcome and immunosuppressive therapy. The rows describe published cases, not the index patient of the article, and the table has no row for the index patient.

pages.contents: Page 1 of Supplementary File S1: a 16-column landscape table with 70 rows of published cases (reference numbers 8 to 62, authors, years 1976 to 2010, countries, gender and age, incubation gap, lesion site and type, systemic involvement, identification technique, pathogen, transplant type, treatments, outcome, immunosuppression). No other text.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Literature-review table of previously published cases from other reports; not the article index patient and not an EHR patient record.
limitations: Small table text was read from a zoomed render of the page; the rows are not transcribed because they are not index-patient data.

pages.contents: Page 2 of Supplementary File S1: continuation of the same table with 54 rows of published cases (reference numbers 62 to 103, years 2010 to 2025), ending with the last row; the lower half of the page is blank.
